user_target: Visible jitter/sliding during handheld micro-motion; fully rigid rest already appears stable. Additional Monado prediction disabled; no SteamVR extrinsic calibration import.

bias_fix.mechanism: Apply configured accel/gyro bias random walk to the separate bias filter, using its error-state indices. Previous assignment targeted the kinematic model and was erased during initialization.
bias_fix.evidence: Both native regression cases fail before and pass after: covariance grows by configured variance times elapsed time, runtime config changes work, predicted bias mean stays unchanged.
bias_fix.observed_jitter: Small changes on supplied static record; no claim of practical handheld-jitter resolution.

static_protocol: Supplied ~48s native input, 20..45s RMS, 200Hz resampling, no additional prediction for primary metrics. Remove every recorded LH_POSE line and use a fresh config for self-calibration; disable automatic floor height for both sides to isolate estimator motion from changing stage offsets. Factory device intrinsics and captured optical/OOTX data retained. These diagnostic choices are not proposed product defaults.
